proposals.description: Fix invalid clusterId 'medicine-healthcare' on 4 international/medical pathways
proposals.rationale: careerClusters.json defines cluster ID as 'medicine-health'. Referencing 'medicine-healthcare' results in broken cluster lookup on career detail pages and AI counsellor filters.

proposals.description: Update entranceExam label on MBBS and BDS institutes from 'NEET UG / KCET' to 'NEET-UG'
proposals.rationale: KCET is NOT an entrance examination for MBBS or BDS in Karnataka or India. Admission is solely through NEET-UG merit (KEA conducts state counselling). Labelling KCET as an entrance exam for medical institutes is legally and factually inaccurate.
proposals.affectedEntities: All Medical (67) and Dental (28) records with entranceExam = 'NEET UG / KCET'
proposals.verifiedSource: National Medical Commission (NMC) Regulations & KEA UGNEET Bulletin (https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in)

proposals.description: Remove fictitious 0.92 rank multiplier for Rural and Kannada Medium quotas
proposals.rationale: In KEA UGCET admissions, Rural (15%) and Kannada Medium (5%) are statutory horizontal seat quotas, not rank multipliers. A candidate's merit rank never changes. Multiplying predicted rank by 0.92 gives students a false inflated rank.
proposals.after:
// Rural (15%) and Kannada Medium (5%) are statutory horizontal reservations.
// Rank remains identical; reservation applies at option entry during seat allotment.
proposals.verifiedSource: KEA UGCET Admission Rules & Government of Karnataka Reservation Orders

proposals.description: Add Category-1 ('1') to KCETInput['category'] union type
proposals.rationale: Karnataka recognizes 8 vertical backward class categories (GM, 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B, SC, ST). Category-1 represents 4% statutory reservation and was omitted from the TypeScript definition.
proposals.verifiedSource: Karnataka State Backward Classes Commission & KEA Category Codes
